text: {"status":"complete","candidates":[{"dialogueCueIds":["c1","c2","c3","c4"],"contextCueIds":[],"utterances":[{"sourceSpans":[{"cueId":"c1","start":0,"end":43}]},{"sourceSpans":[{"cueId":"c2","start":0,"end":10}]},{"sourceSpans":[{"cueId":"c2","start":10,"end":46}]},{"sourceSpans":[{"cueId":"c3","start":0,"end":38}]},{"sourceSpans":[{"cueId":"c4","start":0,"end":8}]}],"learningValue":"這段對話展示了安排事務與分工時的實用句型，包含請求他人行動時的「pedir que + 虛擬式」，以及指涉未來時間點時「cuando + 虛擬式」的典型文法結構。","opportunities":[{"category":"grammar","sourceCueIds":["c1"],"description":"動詞「pedir que」後接虛擬式（envíen）表示要求他人執行某事。"},{"category":"grammar","sourceCueIds":["c3"],"description":"時間副詞「cuando」引導指涉未來的子句時，需搭配虛擬式（tenga），主要子句則使用未來式（avisaré）。"},{"category":"chunks","sourceCueIds":["c1","c2"],"description":"運用「ir a + 原形動詞」（voy a pedir / vamos a revisar）表達個人或團隊接下來打算進行的分工行動。"}]}]}
